features.title: Genres, studios, people, years
features.description: `GET /Genres`, `/Studios`, `/Persons`, `/Years` and their single forms: distinct names carried by what the user may see, counts by type, name filters, paging; opened by id through `/Items/{id}`.
features.reference: Same lists; genre images are generated collages.
features.notes: Image slots are empty; a person nothing visible credits is 404 (the reference answers 200); `TotalRecordCount` of `/Years` is the number of years.

features.title: Filter facets
features.description: `/Items/Filters` (genres, tags, ratings, years of a parent) and `/Items/Filters2` (genres with ids, tags, audio languages).
features.reference: Also lists subtitle languages and uses the user's views.
features.notes: SubtitleLanguages is always empty; AudioLanguages only when item types are named.

features.title: Similar items
features.description: Movies and series ranked by the number of shared genres, studios, people and tags.
features.reference: Same idea; the reference's ranking of ties is not specified.

features.title: Movie recommendations and suggestions
features.description: Categories from the movies the user played last (similar, same director, same actor); a random sample of items as suggestions.
features.reference: Same category kinds (also liked-item categories); suggestions are an unspecified mix of everything.

features.title: Intros and collections of an item
features.description: `/Items/{id}/Intros` is empty (no pre-roll content exists); `/Items/{id}/Collections` lists the collections holding the item.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Favorites of genres, people and studios
features.description: Named items have no stored user data: they are never favorites and `IsFavorite` filters list nothing.
features.reference: A person or genre can be favorited.
features.notes: Needs a per-user store keyed by name rather than by item row.

features.title: Create, add, remove, delete
features.description: `POST /Collections`, `POST/DELETE /Collections/{id}/Items`, `DELETE /Items/{id}`, gated on `EnableCollectionManagement`.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Derived metadata and played state
features.description: Year, genres and lowest rating derived from members; played state aggregated from leaves and written through.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Listing and visibility
features.description: `IncludeItemTypes=BoxSet`, `CollapseBoxSetItems`, library views, per-user visibility of partial members.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Automatic collections
features.description: Built from NFO `<set>` during a movie scan.
features.reference: Same, plus TMDB collection ids.
features.notes: TMDB `belongs_to_collection` is not used.

features.title: Playlists
features.description: No playlist storage or routes.
features.reference: User playlists, shared playlists, reorder, instant mix.
features.notes: In scope for v1 (docs/01), not built.

features.title: Movies
features.description: Scanned: movie folders, loose files, stacked parts and versions.
features.reference: Movie library: one item per movie, grouped by folder or file name.

features.title: TV shows
features.description: Scanned: series, seasons and episodes from folders and file names, `.nfo` and TMDB.
features.reference: TV library: Series/Season/Episode hierarchy.

features.title: Home videos and photos
features.description: Every folder becomes a Folder (PhotoAlbum when it holds pictures), videos become Video items and pictures Photo items; no name parsing or provider lookup.
features.reference: Home videos library with the same folder/photo shapes.

features.title: Collections library
features.description: The Collections library is created with the first collection and shown as a view only while a collection is visible; its scan step is a no-op.
features.reference: Collections library of BoxSets.

features.title: Mixed content
features.description: Accepted as a library type but not scanned: the scan logs `collection type not scanned yet` and skips the path.
features.reference: Mixed (unset) libraries scan movies, series and videos in one tree.
features.notes: Needs a per-folder decision between the movie and series walkers.

features.title: Music
features.description: Accepted as a library type but not scanned; no audio file extensions, no Audio/MusicAlbum/MusicArtist items, no audio playback decision.
features.reference: Music library with artists, albums, tracks, lyrics and instant mixes.
features.notes: Video-first scope (docs/01); not on ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Music videos
features.description: Accepted as a library type but not scanned.
features.reference: MusicVideo items grouped with artists.
features.notes: Not on ROADMAP.md; use homevideos for loose clips.

features.title: Books
features.description: Accepted as a library type but not scanned; there are no Book items.
features.reference: Book/AudioBook libraries.
features.notes: Not on ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Photos library
features.description: Pictures are cataloged only inside a homevideos library (Photo, PhotoAlbum); there is no separate `photos` library type.
features.reference: Photos library type with albums.
features.notes: Covered through homevideos; a dedicated type would only add the view name.

features.title: Playlists library
features.description: A `playlists` library view is listed (empty); playlists themselves do not exist.
features.reference: Playlists library holding user playlists.
features.notes: Depends on the Playlist API (see API: collections-playlists).

features.title: Live TV
features.description: No Live TV library or channels.
features.reference: Live TV view with channels, guide and recordings.
features.notes: Decision D8 (docs/01).

features.title: Names, dates, ratings, runtime
features.description: Name, SortName (with article removal and transliteration), year, PremiereDate, OfficialRating, CommunityRating, RunTimeTicks.
features.reference: Same fields.
features.notes: Transliteration residue is listed in items.md (Known differences).

features.title: Genres, tags, studios, people
features.description: Stored from NFO and TMDB, returned on items and browsable: `/Genres`, `/Studios`, `/Persons`, `/Years` list and open them, `Genres`, `Studios`, `Person`, `GenreIds`, `StudioIds`, `PersonIds` filter `/Items`.
features.reference: Browse, filter and image routes for each.
features.notes: Genre, studio and person images are not generated (their image slots are empty); named items cannot be favorited.

features.title: Parental rating enforcement
features.description: MaxParentalRating, MaxParentalSubRating, BlockUnratedItems, AllowedTags and BlockedTags restrict listings and single reads.
features.reference: Same policy.

features.title: Per-user item data
features.description: Played, PlayCount, favorite, likes, resume position, folder aggregates and played propagation.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Media streams from ffprobe
features.description: Video, audio and embedded subtitle streams, container, bitrate, dimensions and chapters-free media info are probed and returned in MediaSources.
features.reference: Same, plus chapters and attachments.
features.notes: Chapters, chapter images and attachments are not extracted.
features.unverified_reason: Probing needs ffprobe; the fixtures only assert dimensions and runtime.

features.title: Chapters and chapter images
features.description: Chapter markers are not stored or returned.
features.reference: Chapters from the container or from sidecar files, with generated thumbnails.
features.notes: Not on ROADMAP.md; the web chapter menu stays empty.

features.title: Search
features.description: `SearchTerm` on `/Items` and `GET /Search/Hints` match names without regard to case, accents or punctuation, ranked (starts with, ends a word, seasons and episodes, rest); the hints also find genre, studio and person names carried by what the user can see.
features.reference: Hint search across items, people and genres.
features.notes: With a Limit the reference keeps an unspecified subset; Tinyfin keeps the first results of the ranking.

features.title: Sorting, filtering and paging on /Items
features.description: The documented filter, sort and paging parameters of the spec (items.filter, items.sort, items.paging).
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Live TV, DVR, EPG, tuners
features.description: Nothing implemented; `/LiveTv/Programs` answers an empty result for the web client.
features.reference: Tuner hosts, listing providers, guide, timers, recordings.
features.notes: Decision D8.

features.title: Plugins, repositories and packages
features.description: No plugin loader; the metadata provider interface is a fixed Go contract.
features.reference: Runtime .NET plugins and a package catalog.
features.notes: Decisions D8, D11.

features.title: DLNA and SSDP
features.description: No UPnP server, no SSDP discovery.
features.reference: DLNA server and discovery, device profiles.
features.notes: Decision D8.

features.title: UDP autodiscovery (port 7359)
features.description: Not implemented; clients need the address.
features.reference: Answers client discovery broadcasts.
features.notes: Cheap to add; not on ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Notifications and webhooks
features.description: No notification subsystem.
features.reference: Notification providers (plugin-based) and webhooks.
features.notes: Plugin territory.

features.title: Offline sync
features.description: No sync jobs.
features.reference: Download for offline.
features.notes: Decision D8.

features.title: Embedded SQLite storage
features.description: Single-file store with migrations (`0001` to `0021`).
features.reference: SQLite plus EF Core migrations.

features.title: Scale-mode storage driver
features.description: Interface exists; no networked driver.
features.reference: n/a
features.notes: Phase 4 in ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Remote access and network settings
features.description: `EnableRemoteAccess` and local-network detection; no HTTPS, bind addresses or published URIs settings.
features.reference: Full network configuration, HTTPS, base URL, published server URIs.
features.notes: TLS is left to a reverse proxy.

features.title: PlaybackInfo negotiation
features.description: Picks Direct Play, Remux, Direct Stream or Transcode from the device profile by container and codec lists; honors `AudioStreamIndex`/`SubtitleStreamIndex` (query or body, with `MediaSourceId`) and a subtitle delivered by `Encode`/`Hls` ends direct play; `TranscodingUrl` carries the codecs, the tracks, `SubtitleMethod` and `TranscodeReasons`.
features.reference: Evaluates codec profiles, bitrate, level, audio channels, subtitle and HDR conditions.
features.notes: `CodecProfile`/`ContainerProfile` conditions and MaxStreamingBitrate are not evaluated (docs/07 documented simplification); the URL has fewer parameters than the reference's (playback.md, known differences).

features.title: Direct Play and file delivery
features.description: `/Videos/{id}/stream` serves the file with Range and conditional requests.
features.reference: Same.
features.unverified_reason: No contract scenario; verified by real clients (ROADMAP.md).

features.title: HLS transcoding
features.description: One rendition: master playlist, growing media playlist, MPEG-TS segments through `jellyfin-ffmpeg`; the audio track and the burned-in subtitle chosen by the URL (`AudioStreamIndex`, `SubtitleStreamIndex` + `SubtitleMethod=Encode`), one transcode job per selection, replaced when a play session changes track; scale by MaxHeight.
features.reference: Adaptive ladders, fMP4, hardware acceleration, tone mapping, VOD-shaped playlists.
features.notes: H.264/HEVC targets only; no VAAPI/NVENC/QSV flags; burn-in is libass (text) or overlay (bitmap, argument-tested only) with system fonts or `-fonts-dir`; no subtitle group in the playlist; StartTimeTicks of the URL is not applied. The transcoded content (track mapping, rendering) is checked by Go tests with a real ffmpeg, not by the contract runner.

features.title: Hardware acceleration
features.description: No hardware encoder arguments are built.
features.reference: VAAPI, NVENC, QSV, V4L2, AMF, VideoToolbox and tone mapping.
features.notes: docs/07 lists it as the next step of the ladder.

features.title: Subtitle delivery and conversion
features.description: `Stream.{format}` (and with a start position) serves external SubRip/WebVTT/ASS/SSA/SAMI files and embedded text tracks as srt, vtt, ass, ssa, json and ttml with the reference's offsets (`startPositionTicks`, `endPositionTicks`, `copyTimestamps`, `addVttTimeMap`); `subtitles.m3u8` lists the WebVTT windows; PlaybackInfo sets `DeliveryMethod`/`DeliveryUrl` per stream from the device profile's `SubtitleProfiles`.
features.reference: The same, plus subtitle groups in HLS manifests and anonymous access to the stream routes.
features.notes: No subtitle rendition in HLS (delivery `Hls` ends direct play but the playlists have no subtitle group); burn-in is described in playback.hls. Bitmap tracks (PGS, DVD) are never converted. Stream routes need a token (divergence subtitles.stream.R9).

features.title: Default subtitle and audio stream
features.description: `DefaultSubtitleStreamIndex` and `DefaultAudioStreamIndex` on every media source follow the caller's `SubtitleMode`, `SubtitleLanguagePreference` and `AudioLanguagePreference`.
features.reference: Same ranking; the selection is also remembered per item and user.
features.notes: Remembered selections (`RememberSubtitleSelections`) are not applied.

features.title: Subtitle upload and deletion
features.description: `POST /Videos/{id}/Subtitles` saves a base64 file beside the video (`<name>.<lang>[.forced][.sdh].<ext>`, numbered when taken) and `DELETE /Videos/{id}/Subtitles/{index}` removes an external file; the item's streams are updated at once.
features.reference: Same; the file lands in the media folder or the server's data folder by library option.
features.notes: Always saved beside the video (`SaveSubtitlesWithMedia` is not honored).

features.title: Remote subtitle providers
features.description: The search, download and provider routes exist and answer like a server with no provider installed; `GET /FallbackFont/Fonts` lists nothing.
features.reference: Plugins (OpenSubtitles and others) search and download subtitles into the media folder; a fonts folder feeds ASS rendering.
features.notes: Needs provider plugins and network access, outside the single-binary no-dependency scope (AGENTS.md principle 2).

features.title: Trickplay thumbnails
features.description: Libraries with `EnableTrickplayImageExtraction` get JPEG sprite sheets (320 px or the video's width, 10 s interval, 10x10 grid) generated by ffmpeg in a background job after the scan, incrementally, one process at a time by default. Served as a tiles playlist and sheets; listed in `Trickplay` on the item.
features.reference: Same sheets, generated during the scan or by a daily task; width, interval, grid, quality and threads come from server configuration.
features.notes: Width, interval, grid and quality are fixed at the reference's defaults (no `TrickplayOptions`); no scheduled task, a refresh with `RegenerateTrickplay=true` regenerates.

features.title: Media segments
features.description: Route registered; no segment data is produced (no intro/credits detection).
features.reference: Segments from providers or plugins.
features.notes: Always an honest empty list.

features.title: Bitrate test
features.description: `GET /Playback/BitrateTest` returns random bytes sized as the reference.
features.reference: Same.
features.unverified_reason: Shape checked by hand against the reference; no scenario.

features.title: Lyrics
features.description: No lyric files cataloged or served.
features.reference: LRC/TXT lyrics for audio.
features.notes: Music is not cataloged.

features.title: Audio streaming and universal endpoint
features.description: No audio items.
features.reference: `/Audio/{id}/stream`, `/universal`.
features.notes: Music is not cataloged.

features.title: Transcode worker on a separate machine
features.description: The transcode manager is an in-process component; no remote worker role.
features.reference: n/a (the reference is single-process).
features.notes: Phase 4 in ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Device profile database
features.description: Profiles for known clients are compiled in and chosen from the client's declared profile or name.
features.reference: Profiles come from the client and a built-in database.
features.unverified_reason: Covered by Go unit tests in internal/scan, not by a contract scenario.

features.title: Playlists and entries
features.description: Create (body or query form), read, update, add, remove and move entries; an item may repeat; series, seasons, folders and collections expand to their playable items; genres, studios, rating and running time are derived from the entries.
features.reference: Same routes.
features.notes: A move to an index outside the list is 400 (the reference answers 500); metadata is refreshed on every change.

features.title: Ownership, open access and shares
features.description: Owner, open flag and per-user share with a CanEdit flag; hidden playlists are 404; the owner lists and manages shares.
features.reference: Same model; the reference's share removal is a no-op and its share-add can leave edit access ungranted.

features.title: Playlists view and deletion
features.description: A Playlists view in the user's views once a playlist is readable, listing the readable playlists; the owner deletes a playlist through `DELETE /Items/{id}`.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Play start/progress/stop reporting
features.description: `/Sessions/Playing*` update user data, now-playing state and the activity log.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Session registry
features.description: In-process registry fed by authentication and playback; `GET /Sessions` is admin-only.
features.reference: Registry also carries remote-control state, capabilities and additional users.
features.notes: Remote control routes missing.

features.title: WebSocket `/socket`
features.description: Upgrade with `ApiKey`; server messages: ForceKeepAlive, Sessions, ScheduledTasksInfo, ActivityLogEntry, UserUpdated; client messages: KeepAlive and the *Start/*Stop subscriptions.
features.reference: Also UserDataChanged, LibraryChanged, PlaybackStart/Stop, GeneralCommand, Play/Playstate, RestartRequired, PackageInstalling.
features.notes: Library and user-data change pushes are not sent; remote commands do not exist.

features.title: SyncPlay
features.description: No groups, no routes (404 on /SyncPlay/List, which the web client tolerates).
features.reference: Group watch with shared queue and playback sync.
features.notes: Not in v1 scope.

features.title: Remote control (commands, messages)
features.description: Not implemented although the transport exists.
features.reference: Send play/pause/seek/message commands to a session.
features.notes: Transport (/socket) exists; command routes do not.

features.title: Scale-mode session state (Redis/Valkey)
features.description: Only the in-process driver exists.
features.reference: n/a
features.notes: Phase 4 in ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Movie names and years
features.description: Folder or file text is the name; a trailing `(Year)` is read as the year; release tokens after the year are cut; versions and stacked parts become media sources.
features.reference: Movie naming with year in parentheses; trailing release tags are removed.
features.notes: Release token list is the probed subset (items.md, Known differences).

features.title: Episode numbering forms
features.description: `SxxExx`, `1x05`, `E05E06E07`, `S01E02E03`, `Show - 05`, bare and four digit numbers, `Season 2 Episode 13`, `[S02E15]`, dates; `IndexNumberEnd` for ranges.
features.reference: Parses the same forms from names, folder and sidecar.
features.notes: Exotic letter/digit combinations differ (items.md, Known differences).

features.title: Season folders
features.description: `Season N`, `Specials`, any other folder as a named season, folders sharing a number counted once, folders without videos plain `Folder`, episode-named folders plain `Folder`.
features.reference: Seasons from folders; extras folders skipped.

features.title: Video extensions
features.description: `.mkv .mp4 .avi .webm .m4v .ts .mov .wmv .flv .mpg .mpeg .ogv .3gp .m2ts .vob .divx .strm .iso .img` (case-insensitive).
features.reference: Broader list driven by the container probe.
features.notes: No `.rmvb`, `.asf`, `.m2v`, `.mts`.
features.unverified_reason: Covered by Go unit tests in internal/scan and by the disc and strm scenarios for the new members.

features.title: Disc structures (VIDEO_TS, BDMV, .iso, .img)
features.description: A folder with a `VIDEO_TS` holding VOBs, `VIDEO_TS.IFO` plus VOBs, or a `BDMV` is one Movie (`VideoType` Dvd/BluRay, `Path` the folder); `.iso`/`.img` are Movies of `VideoType` Iso with `IsoType` read from the ISO 9660 directory. DVD media info is the main title set's (duration summed, `Data` track included).
features.reference: Same shapes; Blu-ray media info through the disc's playlist.
features.notes: Blu-ray folders fall back to the largest `.m2ts` when ffprobe lacks `bluray:`; UDF-only images are detected heuristically (unverified); streaming a disc folder differs (see specs/scan.md).

features.title: `.strm` files
features.description: A `.strm` is a Movie/Episode/Video whose media source is the address on its first line (Protocol Http, IsRemote) or, for a local path or an empty file, the file itself; nothing is probed at scan time; PlaybackInfo probes the address and keeps the result; the stream is proxied (500 when unreachable).
features.reference: Same.
features.notes: Only http/https addresses are proxied; other schemes answer 500.

features.title: External subtitle files
features.description: `.srt .ass .ssa .vtt .smi .sami .sup` files named after the video (`<video>.<lang>[.forced][.default][.sdh].<ext>`, a free title, any case) are listed as MediaStreams of the video, ahead of its own streams, in the reference's file-name order, from the scan's one folder listing per directory. Added, removed or renamed files are seen on every scan without re-probing the video.
features.reference: The same, with the codec decided by probing the file's content and zero-length files dropped.
features.notes: The codec follows the extension; `.sub`/`.idx` (decided by content on the reference) are not listed; zero-length files are listed.

features.title: External audio tracks
features.description: Not cataloged.
features.reference: Lists external audio files next to the video.
features.notes: Not on ROADMAP.md.

features.title: `.ignore` and exclusion rules
features.description: Empty `.ignore` excludes its folder; otherwise gitignore-like name patterns (nearest file wins, slash patterns never match, case-insensitive); `.nomedia` has no effect; hidden folders and the fixed names (`@eaDir`, `#recycle`, `Subs`, ...) are never cataloged; extras-named folders under a movie library root are plain folders.
features.reference: Same, probed on 12.2.

features.title: Stacked parts and versions
features.description: `Name - part1/part2` stack into one item with AdditionalParts; `Name - 4K` style extra files become media sources of one item.
features.reference: Multi-part stacking and multiple versions of a movie.

features.title: Trailers, specials, theme songs and videos
features.description: Cataloged as items owned by their movie/series/season: `trailers/`, `extras/`, `behind the scenes/` and similar folders, `-trailer` and `-sample` suffixes, `theme.mp3` and `backdrops`-style theme folders.
features.reference: Local trailers, special features and themes served by dedicated routes.

features.title: Local artwork
features.description: `poster`, `folder`, `cover`, `<video>-poster`, `fanart`, `backdrop<N>`, `extrafanart/`, `logo`, `banner`, `art`, `thumb`, `disc`; season and episode pictures; `png jpg jpeg webp tbn gif`; blurhash and change-tagged URLs.
features.reference: Same name and extension rules.

features.title: Embedded artwork extraction
features.description: Pictures are not extracted from video files; only sidecar files and provider artwork are used.
features.reference: Extracts a Primary image from each video by grabbing a frame.
features.notes: The reference extracts a frame; Tinyfin leaves the item without Primary art instead (idle cost, no ffmpeg run per file).

features.title: NFO sidecars
features.description: `<movie>`, `<tvshow>`, `<episodedetails>` (several documents merge), `<namedseason>`; title, originaltitle, sorttitle, plot, year, premiered/aired, genre, tag, mpaa, ratings, uniqueid, set, runtime, season/episode. Also `<studio>`, `<actor>` (role, type, order), `<director>`, `<credits>` and `<writer>`.
features.reference: Reads the Kodi NFO schema including cast and studios.
features.notes: Not read: `<trailer>`, `<fileinfo>`, actor thumbnails, artist/album NFOs.

features.title: TMDB enrichment
features.description: Movies, series, seasons and episodes are enriched (overview, genres, studios, people, ratings, artwork) when `-tmdb-api-key` is set; catalog-only scanning otherwise.
features.reference: TMDB plus several other providers (TVDB, OMDb, MusicBrainz, AniDB, ...).
features.notes: TVDB provider not implemented (ROADMAP.md); no other online provider.
features.unverified_reason: Needs a TMDB key and network; verified by Go unit tests with a fake server, never by the contract (the reference runs offline there).

features.title: Other metadata providers
features.description: The provider interface is an in-process Go contract (decision D11); no TVDB, OMDb, MusicBrainz, AniDB, Fanart.
features.reference: Many providers, extensible by plugins.
features.notes: Plugins are out of scope; TVDB is listed in ROADMAP.md as not implemented.

features.title: Metadata savers (write NFO/images to disk)
features.description: The scanner never writes next to media files; library paths can be read-only.
features.reference: Optionally saves NFO and images beside the media.
features.notes: Read-only media mounts are a design goal; editing is left to external tools.

features.title: Remove items whose file disappeared
features.description: A library scan and the refresh of a series, season or folder forget items whose file or folder is gone (children, extras, collection and playlist membership with them); users' play state is kept; an inaccessible or empty library folder forgets nothing.
features.reference: Same.
features.notes: Image files cached for a forgotten item are removed.

features.title: Realtime library monitor
features.description: A library with `EnableRealtimeMonitor` true is watched with inotify (Linux); a first-level folder that changed and stayed quiet for 30 s is re-walked. Off unless the option is sent.
features.reference: Watches folders and refreshes on change (about 40 s).
features.notes: Linux only; one watch per folder (inotify limit applies); network mounts that do not deliver events are not covered by it.

features.title: Incremental scan
features.description: Files whose size and mtime match their stored signature reuse the stored media info instead of running `ffprobe`; `-scan-force-probe` re-probes everything.
features.reference: Re-probes on a schedule or when the file changes.
features.unverified_reason: Covered by Go unit tests in internal/scan, not by a contract scenario.

features.title: Parallel scanning
features.description: Per-library worker pool, global ffprobe bound and up to three libraries at once; one directory listing per folder.
features.reference: Sequential per library.
features.unverified_reason: Throughput is measured by hand, not asserted by a test.

features.title: LibraryOptions
features.description: Persisted and returned as sent. Applied by a scan: `PathInfos`, `AutomaticallyAddToCollection`, `EnableRealtimeMonitor`, `EnablePhotos`, `SeasonZeroDisplayName`, `EnableEmbeddedTitles`, and the trickplay members `EnableTrickplayImageExtraction`, `ExtractTrickplayImagesDuringLibraryScan`, `SaveTrickplayWithMedia` (playback.trickplay). Stored and inert: `Enabled`, `EnableAutomaticSeriesGrouping`, `SaveLocalMetadata`/`MetadataSavers`, language and country, embedded episode info, chapter images, fetcher members.
features.reference: Most options change scanner or provider behavior; `DisabledLocalMetadataReaders` has no effect on `.nfo` reading.
features.notes: `Enabled` false hides the library on the reference and is not reproduced.

features.title: Automatic collections from NFO `<set>`
features.description: Movies sharing a `<set>` name join a BoxSet when `AutomaticallyAddToCollection` is on and at least two movies share it.
features.reference: Same behavior.

features.title: Library and item refresh
features.description: `POST /Library/Refresh` starts a scan; `POST /Items/{id}/Refresh` on a library is a scan of it, on a series, season or folder re-walks it (new files, vanished files) before the metadata refresh, on another item refreshes its metadata.
features.reference: Same routes; refresh modes change what is re-fetched.
features.notes: Refresh modes (`MetadataRefreshMode`, `ImageRefreshMode`, `ReplaceAllMetadata`) are accepted and ignored; `Recursive` has no effect (a folder is always re-walked).

features.title: System info
features.description: Public info, full info (open until set up), endpoint info, storage info.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Server configuration
features.description: `GET/POST /System/Configuration` and the `network` key; `EnableRemoteAccess=false` answers 503 to non-local requests.
features.reference: Typed named configurations (encoding, metadata, xbmc, branding) and the full object.
features.notes: Other named keys missing.
features.unverified_reason: Network behavior is unit tested only (items.md, Known differences).

features.title: Scheduled tasks
features.description: One task (library scan) with start; reported over the socket.
features.reference: Many tasks (cleanup, trickplay, subtitles, plugins) with triggers.
features.notes: No triggers API, no other tasks.

features.title: Activity log
features.description: Login, failed login, lockout and playback entries.
features.reference: Also library, plugin and task events.
features.notes: Deliberately narrow.

features.title: Server logs
features.description: No log routes.
features.reference: List and download server log files.
features.notes: Not on ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Restart and shutdown
features.description: Not implemented.
features.reference: Restart and shut down the process.
features.notes: A supervisor handles restarts.

features.title: Localization and cultures
features.description: Cultures, countries and library option metadata; no UI string tables.
features.reference: Same plus localization options and parental rating lists.
features.notes: Options and ParentalRatings routes missing.

features.title: Branding
features.description: `/Branding/Configuration` defaults only.
features.reference: Custom CSS, login disclaimer and splash screen.
features.notes: Only defaults are returned.

features.title: Backup and restore
features.description: No archive format; the SQLite file is the backup.
features.reference: Backup archive of config and database.
features.notes: Decision-free: not on ROADMAP.md.

features.title: Bundled web client
features.description: Official `jellyfin-web` served at `/web/` when built with `WITH_WEB=true`.
features.reference: Bundled.
features.unverified_reason: Build option; verified by the browser end-to-end suite in e2e/.

features.title: Path case and trailing slash
features.description: Routes match case-insensitively and with a trailing slash.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Ping, UTC time and localization lists
features.description: `/System/Ping` (GET and POST), `/GetUtcTime`, `/Localization/Options`, `/Localization/ParentalRatings`, `/Localization/Cultures`, `/Localization/Countries`.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Password login
features.description: `POST /Users/AuthenticateByName` with bcrypt, lockout counter, device records and tokens; legacy `X-Emby-*` headers refused by design.
features.reference: Same, plus legacy header schemes.

features.title: QuickConnect
features.description: Initiate, connect, authorize, exchange; secrets are single use (divergence).
features.reference: Same, secret replayable for ten minutes.

features.title: API keys
features.description: Create, list, revoke, use via `ApiKey` query or Authorization.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: Alternative authentication providers (LDAP, SSO)
features.description: Only the built-in password provider; no provider plugins.
features.reference: Plugin-provided providers (LDAP, SSO, ...).
features.notes: Plugins are out of scope (D8).

features.title: Forgot password and PIN
features.description: PIN file based reset with throttling and a bare file name (divergence).
features.reference: Same flow, absolute PIN path, no throttling.

features.title: User CRUD, password and configuration
features.description: Create, read, list, update, delete, password change, per-user configuration, legacy per-user aliases the web client calls.
features.reference: Same.

features.title: User policy
features.description: Administrator, disabled, library access (`EnabledFolders`), parental rating, tags, collection management, device restriction, lockout threshold and access schedules.
features.reference: Same.
features.notes: Not enforced: `EnableContentDeletion`, `EnableMediaConversion`, `MaxActiveSessions`, `RemoteClientBitrateLimit`, download permission (stored, ignored).

features.title: First-run wizard
features.description: Configuration, user, remote access and complete; no default account is created (divergence).
features.reference: Same flow with an empty-password root account.
features.unverified_reason: Fresh-server scenarios are run separately and are not in the baseline.

features.title: Display preferences
features.description: Per-user, per-client preferences are stored and returned.
features.reference: Same.
features.unverified_reason: No scenario; verified by the web client (docs/11).

features.title: User images
features.description: No user image storage.
features.reference: Upload, serve and delete a user avatar.
features.notes: Not on ROADMAP.md.
